title: American Heart Association — Debiasing Clinical Care Algorithms Grant

markdown.headingText: American Heart Association — Debiasing Clinical Care Algorithms Grant
markdown.markdown:
**Principal Investigator | 2024–2025 **

The American Heart Association's Debiasing Clinical Care Algorithms program supports trainees in conducting independent research examining the use of race and ethnicity in clinical decision-making algorithms. As the PI of this award, I led our project, titled *“Re-evaluating the Role of Race/Ethnicity in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) Coronary Heart Disease Risk Score,”* under the guidance of Robyn McClelland.

Our work focused on developing and evaluating a race-free version of the MESA Risk Score, with the goal of understanding how removing race and ethnicity as predictors affects cardiovascular risk prediction.


### Publications

1. **White, Q.**, Hansen, S., Saldivar Murphy, B., Johnson, C., DeFilippis, A., Post, W., & McClelland, R. L. (2026). Reevaluating the use of race/ethnicity in the MESA risk score. *Journal of the American Heart Association, 15*(13), e047013. https://doi.org/10.1161/JAHA.125.047013

2. Cai, X., **White, Q.**, Juarez, J., Chehab, O., Ambale-Venkatesh, B., Johnson, W. C., Hansen, S. L., Inoue, K., Lima, J. A. C., Watson, K. E., & McClelland, R. L. (2026). Association of subclinical cardiac remodeling with incident cancer in the MESA cohort. *Journal of the American Heart Association, 15*(12), e050573. https://doi.org/10.1161/JAHA.125.050573

3. Arai, D., **White, Q.**, Ichikawa, K., McClelland, R. L., Johnson, W. C., Yabuki, M., Hansen, S., & Budoff, M. J. (2026). Association between depressive symptoms and thoracic aortic calcification, and their independent and joint prognostic value for incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease in the MESA cohort. *The International Journal of Cardiovascular Imaging, 42*(10), 1973–1981. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10554-026-03771-0

4. Cai, X., **White, Q.**, Johnson, W. C., Hansen, S. L., Dardari, Z. A., Blaha, M., Michos, E. D., Lima, J. A. C., deFilippi, C. R., Budoff, M. J., Watson, K. E., McClelland, R. L., & Yang, E. H. (2025). Baseline cardiac biomarker levels as predictors of cancer risk in the MESA cohort. *JACC: Advances, 4*(7), 101884. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jacadv.2025.101884

5. Cai, X., **White, Q.**, Wang, D. R., deFilippi, C. R., Bertoni, A. G., Wu, C. O., Liu, K., Lima, J. A. C., Budoff, M. J., Fonarow, G. C., Watson, K. E., McClelland, R. L., & Yang, E. H. (2024). Cardiovascular risks and outcomes among Chinese American immigrants: Insights from the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis. *Journal of the American Heart Association, 13*(18). https://doi.org/10.1161/JAHA.124.037114

6. Witkowski, S.\*, **White, Q.\***, Shreyer, S., Garcia, R. L., Brown, D. E., & Sievert, L. L. (2024). Acute increases in physical activity and temperature are associated with hot flash experience in midlife women. *Menopause, 31*(7). https://doi.org/10.1097/GME.0000000000002373

7. Witkowski, S.\*, **White, Q.\***, Shreyer, S., Brown, D. E., & Sievert, L. L. (2024). The influence of habitual physical activity and sedentary behavior on objective and subjective hot flashes at midlife. *Menopause, 31*(5). https://doi.org/10.1097/GME.0000000000002341

8. Shireman, J. M., **White, Q.**, Ni, Z., Mohanty, C., Cai, Y., Zhao, L., Agrawal, N., Gonugunta, N., Wang, X., McCarthy, L., Kasulabada, V., Pattnaik, A., Ahmed, A. U., Miller, J., Kulwin, C., Cohen-Gadol, A., Payner, T., Lin, C.-T., Savage, J. J., Lane, B., Shiue, K., Kamer, A., Shah, M., Iyer, G., Watson, G., Kendziorski, C., & Dey, M. (2024). Genomic analysis of human brain metastases treated with stereotactic radiosurgery reveals unique signature based on treatment failure. *iScience, 27*(4), 109601. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2024.109601

9. Witkowski, S., Evard, R., Rickson, J. J., **White, Q.**, & Sievert, L. L. (2023). Physical activity and exercise for hot flashes: Trigger or treatment? *Menopause, 30*(2). https://doi.org/10.1097/GME.0000000000002107

10. Barnes, P., Smith, K., Parrish, R., Jones, C., Skinner, P., Storch, E., **White, Q.**, Deng, C., Karsann, D., Lau, M. L., Dumais, J. J., Dufek, E. J., & Xiong, H. (2020). A non-aqueous sodium hexafluorophosphate-based electrolyte degradation study: Formation and mitigation of hydrofluoric acid. *Journal of Power Sources, 447*, 227363. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpowsour.2019.227363

\* Equal contribution.

## Conference Presentations

- **White, Q.**, Hansen, S., Saldivar Murphy, B., Johnson, C., DeFilippis, A., Post, W., & McClelland, R. (2024, November). *Re-evaluating the use of race/ethnicity in the MESA risk score*. Poster presented at the American Heart Association Scientific Sessions.

- **White, Q.**, Greco, M., Sleith, R., Weiner, A., & Katz, L. A. (2021, January). *Population structure in uncultivable protists: A novel approach*. Poster presented at the Pioneer Valley Microbiology Symposium.

- **White, Q.** (2021, October). *Will telehealth revolutionize access to mental health care?* Poster presented at the Science, Technology and Human Rights Conference.
